trigger: Bluetooth closes and reopens UART before the first 115200-baud peripheral wake
cause: 7.3 upstream disable_irq at shutdown entry and carried downstream disable_irq_nosync at exit each increment depth; startup decrements only once, leaving interrupts masked
fix: remove the duplicate downstream disable; retain upstream shutdown synchronization and status draining

regression.method: compile actual driver startup/shutdown functions with IRQ and runtime-PM mocks
regression.before: fails IRQ/PM invariant after first shutdown
regression.after: passes 16 open/close cycles on console and non-console, PM-resume failure, setup failure and retry
regression.scope: host lifecycle regression; hardware Bluetooth success is pending p4 boot

observed_p3: peripheral-version-115200 timeout, byte_tx=1 byte_rx=0; same as p2
p4_hardware_result: two firmware bootstrap completions ret0, controller powered, user confirms Settings switch and Bluetooth connection/use normal
